Payment & Revenue: Polling a still-PENDING payment's status live-queries PayOS and can self-expire it after 15 minutes — a SEPARATE, earlier expiry path than the 30-minute background scheduler.
column3:
1. Create a PENDING payment (PAYMENT_FT27) and do NOT complete it in the PayOS sandbox.
2. Seed/wait until the payment's createdAt is more than 15 minutes old.
3. Prepare and send GET /api/v1/payment/status/{txnRef}.
4. Inspect the response and the Payment row.
column4:
1. If PayOS reports the order as PAID, this SAME poll call fulfills the payment itself (status→SUCCESS, enrollment/notification fire) even with no webhook delivered.
2. Otherwise, once createdAt is >15 minutes old, this poll call flips the Payment straight to EXPIRED on the spot — independent of, and earlier than, PaymentExpirationScheduler's 30-minute sweep (which only catches payments nobody has polled).
column5: - A PENDING payment older than 15 minutes; PayOS sandbox reachable.
